channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: any_to_any.py – Audio & Video
item.description: Universal media converter that can convert, merge, concatenate and resize a wide range of audio, video, image and document formats on Windows.

item.title: ArSee – Developer Tools
item.description: ArSee is a free Windows tool that reads raw IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 traffic and shows it as readable frames, logs, and PDF evidence reports for testing and troubleshooting.

item.title: AudioSync – Audio & Video
item.description: AudioSync lets you play your computer's sound on multiple AirPlay, Google Cast, Bluetooth and other speakers at the same time, keeping them in sync.

item.title: AzioVoice Recorder – Audio & Video
item.description: AzioVoice Recorder is a modern Windows app for recording audio from any input device with optional filters and easy file management.

item.title: Basemind – Developer Tools
item.description: Basemind provides a code‑aware context and communication layer for AI coding agents, letting them query code structure, git history, documents and shared memory without loading whole files.

item.title: Brovan – Developer Tools
item.description: Brovan is a user‑mode x86_64 emulator that lets you run, trace and analyze Windows and Linux binaries on Windows, Linux and Android.

item.title: ClamAV – Security & Privacy
item.description: ClamAV is an open‑source antivirus engine that scans for viruses, trojans, malware and other malicious threats.

item.title: ClipTyper – System Utilities
item.description: Types clipboard text as keystrokes when pasting is not possible, such as in VM consoles, iLO/iDRAC, and remote sessions without a shared clipboard.

item.title: DMR Studio – Audio & Video
item.description: DMR Studio is a Windows desktop program that automatically records livestreams, captures and renders chat comments (danmaku), manages recording tasks and can upload the finished videos.

item.title: Docbank – Productivity & Office
item.description: Docbank is an open‑source local document vault that stores PDFs, images, text files and other records, makes their text searchable, tracks versions and lets you export verified bundles.

item.title: DYGTube – Audio & Video
item.description: Download MP3 and MP4 files from online video services using a simple Windows interface.

item.title: ED Unofficial Patch – Games
item.description: Unofficial fixes and DLSS, FSR and XeSS upscaling for Elite Dangerous: Odyssey, in VR and flat

item.title: File 2 Startup – System Utilities
item.description: A desktop application that lets you add, edit, and remove executable files from the Windows startup list easily.

item.title: File Converter Pro – File Management
item.description: Free offline all‑in‑one file converter for Windows that handles documents, images, audio and video without uploading anything.

item.title: FluentControl – System Utilities
item.description: A Windows tool that lets you control monitor brightness, contrast, color settings, input source, system volume, microphone and mouse speed from a single panel, with support for multiple monitors and offline use.

item.title: Foundation Sunshine – Games
item.description: Foundation Sunshine is a free open‑source remote streaming host that lets you view and control your Windows desktop, applications and games from another device with low latency, HDR and controller support.

item.title: Homura – Productivity & Office
item.description: Homura is a local comic, light‑novel and ebook reader for Windows that supports many formats and keeps your reading data on the device.

item.title: Hydra Dragon Antivirus – Security & Privacy
item.description: An open‑source antivirus and endpoint detection and response tool that combines ClamAV, YARA, machine‑learning analysis and other security components for Windows.

item.title: iMA Menu – System Utilities
item.description: iMA Menu adds customizable context‑menu items, theming and a set of handy tools to the Windows desktop.

item.title: IME Mode Persistence – System Utilities
item.description: A small Windows tray utility that remembers the last input method conversion mode (Chinese/English) when switching windows and can lock specific programs to a chosen input language, even for fullscreen games.

item.title: Last Wallpaper – System Utilities
item.description: Shows a picture‑of‑the‑day on your desktop from sources such as Bing, NASA, Wikipedia, Copernicus and more.

item.title: LibreSVIP – File Management
item.description: A universal converter for many Singing Voice Synthesis project formats.

item.title: MiniDock – System Utilities
item.description: MiniDock provides a lightweight Dock and a macOS‑style top status bar for Windows, letting you keep frequently used apps, windows, and system information easily accessible.

item.title: mpv AnimeJaNai – Audio & Video
item.description: Real-time anime upscaling to 4K in mpv with lightweight super-resolution models.

item.title: New Pokemon Snap Recomp – Games
item.description: A native Windows version of New Pokémon Snap that runs your own legally obtained copy of the Switch game on PC with higher resolutions and frame rates.

item.title: OpenCompare – Productivity & Office
item.description: OpenCompare is a free desktop tool for comparing and merging files, folders, CSV, JSON and YAML, offering visual diff and sync capabilities.

item.title: OptiScaler – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: OptiScaler lets you replace or add upscaling and frame‑generation technologies in games that already support DLSS, FSR or XeSS, giving you more control over image quality and performance.

item.title: PaperDuet – Productivity & Office
item.description: PaperDuet lets you view a PDF and its AI translation side by side, keeping formulas, figures and tables aligned, and organizes your papers in a visual library.

item.title: PATHS – System Utilities
item.description: Command-line app to add, remove or clean the PATH and PATHEXT environment variables on Windows.

item.title: PS5 Dump Image Converter – Developer Tools
item.description: A graphical tool for converting, validating and managing PS5 and PS4 dump folders, image files and package containers on Windows.

item.title: Purffle Grab – Audio & Video
item.description: Free desktop downloader for YouTube, Spotify, TikTok, Instagram, SoundCloud and over a thousand other sites, allowing you to save videos and music as MP3, FLAC, MP4 up to 4K.

item.title: PYAS Security – Security & Privacy
item.description: A hybrid Windows endpoint security program that combines machine‑learning scanning, YARA rules, cloud analysis and a kernel‑level driver to protect against malware and unwanted behavior.

item.title: Raiden Video Ripper – Audio & Video
item.description: A simple Windows program for trimming videos and converting them to MP4, GIF, WebM or MP3 formats.

item.title: Readest – Productivity & Office
item.description: Readest is a free, open‑source ebook reader for Windows that handles many ebook formats, lets you annotate, search, and customize the reading view.

item.title: REAL Video Enhancer – Audio & Video
item.description: Easily interpolate, upscale, decompress and denoise videos.

item.title: Recompia – Games
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2) recompiled to run natively on Windows with multiplayer support.

item.title: SmoothScroll – System Utilities
item.description: Free smooth-scrolling utility for Windows – velocity-based easing engine with per‑app profiles and zero telemetry.

item.title: SmoovPlay – Games
item.description: SmoovPlay streams console games to your PC and uses AI to generate extra frames, giving smoother playback at higher frame rates.

item.title: SnapSharp – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: SnapSharp is a Windows tool for taking screenshots, annotating them, performing OCR, translating text, removing backgrounds and recording the screen, all with local AI models.

item.title: StreamNook – Audio & Video
item.description: A native desktop client that lets you watch Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok streams in one window, with chat and emotes integrated.

item.title: The Last Guardian Definitive – Games
item.description: A fan-made Windows port of The Last Guardian that adds photo mode, free camera, texture upgrades, controller support and many hidden features.

item.title: Timetrack – Productivity & Office
item.description: A simple desktop application that lets you record how much time you spend on different projects.

item.title: Upscayl – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Free and open‑source AI image upscaler for Windows.

item.title: VideoCutter – Audio & Video
item.description: VideoCutter lets you download only a selected part of an online video or audio source as a separate file, without needing a video editor.

item.title: VideoLow – Audio & Video
item.description: VideoLow is a lightweight free GUI for FFmpeg on Windows that lets you compress, transcode and trim video and audio files.

item.title: VirtualPaper – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: VirtualPaper is a free, open‑source wallpaper application for Windows that lets you use images, videos, GIFs and interactive web wallpapers with built‑in editing, 3D parallax and atmosphere effects.

item.title: Vitrine – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A free, non‑destructive RAW photo editor for Windows that uses GPU acceleration and AI tools for upscaling and motion deblur.

item.title: WebP Converter – Audio & Video
item.description: Convert animated WebP images to video formats such as MP4, MKV, WebM, or GIF on Windows.

item.title: Windows Optimize Harden Debloat GUI – System Utilities
item.description: A graphical interface that lets you inspect and run the Windows Optimize Harden Debloat PowerShell script with selectable options.

item.title: WinShun – Productivity & Office
item.description: WinShun is a free, open‑source Windows search launcher that lets you find files, content inside documents, apps, settings and clipboard history by pressing Ctrl twice.
